stemBlocks: The graph shows the rate of removal of sodium ions from a giant axon in a squid. Between 100 and 230 minutes, a reversible inhibitor of mitochondrial activity was present.
Which of the following statements is/are correct?

1 The removal of sodium ions across the cell surface membrane of the axon is an active process requiring ATP.
2 The concentration of sodium ions in the axon must increase after the inhibitor has been removed.
3 In the 50 minutes before the inhibitor was added, the rate of removal of sodium ions from the axon decreases by $4.4 \times 10^{-3}$ arbitrary units per minute.

assets.alt: Graph showing the rate of removal of sodium ions from an axon over time, with an inhibitor of mitochondrial activity present between 100 and 230 minutes.
